name: vision_unet_seg
title: A U-Net segmentation trainer with albumentations and a Dice+BCE objective, written correctly
origin: domain-vision round 1: the shape of every binary-segmentation repo - paired image/mask folders, an albumentations pipeline per split, a Dice+BCE loss and an IoU metric

forbidden.why: eval_augmentation() is Resize + Normalize + ToTensorV2; every random albumentations operator lives in train_augmentation()
the training loader is built with shuffle=True
the validation and test loaders are built with shuffle=False
the loaders are built inside build_loaders(), reached only from main() under the __main__ guard in train.py
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is the first statement of the training step
optimizer.step() follows loss.backward()
the order is backward -> clip -> step
the only no_grad region is the @torch.no_grad()-decorated validate(), which contains no backward()
the epoch loss accumulates loss.item()
CosineAnnealingLR is an epoch schedule and scheduler.step() is called once per epoch
clip_grad_norm_ sits between backward() and step()
validate() calls model.eval() first and restores model.train() at the end
validate() carries the @torch.no_grad() decorator
there is no softmax and no CrossEntropyLoss in this project
UNet.forward returns the bare 1x1 convolution - logits - and the objective is BCEWithLogitsLoss, which is the correct pairing; the Dice term applies its own torch.sigmoid explicitly
both the images and the masks are moved to the model's device in every loop
pick_device() checks torch.cuda.is_available()
seed_everything() seeds random, numpy, torch and torch.cuda
there is no random split: the three splits are three directories
DoubleConv, UNet and DiceBCELoss all call super().__init__()
the down and up stacks are nn.ModuleList instances
torch.save writes a dict of state_dict()s and torch.load passes map_location= and weights_only=True
